sources.title: Warsh shakes up Fed's approach to setting interest rates
Warsh shakes up Fed's approach to setting interest rates
European Equities Rise in Thursday Trading; ECB Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
ECB Leaves Rates Unchanged, Cites Energy Shock as Inflation Driver as December Hike Moves Into Focus
Inflation surges, PCE shows. Fed pause on rate hikes unlikely to last with prices still rising.
US economy grows faster than expected but inflation rises to 3.7%
As voters struggle with pricey car loans, mortgages and credit-card debt, the cost of money itself is on the ballot
Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady After September Hikes
Federal Reserve’s preferred measure of inflation rose slightly in September

en.title: Fed holds rates steady as Warsh changes interest-rate approach
en.dek: The Federal Reserve left its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday, and new chair Jerome Warsh said the Fed will alter its method for setting rates.
facts: The Fed kept its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
The personal consumption expenditures index rose to 3.7% in September (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
The PCE index increased in September after falling in August (The Hill, New York Times).
The European Central Bank left its interest rates unchanged (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh announced a change to the Fed’s rate‑setting approach (WPEC, KATU).
body: Jerome Warsh said the Federal Reserve will modify the way it sets interest rates, according to WPEC and KATU. The announcement came on the same day the Fed released its policy decision.
The Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday, MarketWatch reported and Conduit Street Blog confirmed. The decision maintained the target range at its current level.
The personal consumption expenditures (PCE) price index rose to 3.7% in September, The Guardian noted. MarketWatch added that the cost of living rose sharply again last month.
The Hill and the New York Times reported that the PCE index increased in September after a decline in August. Both outlets said the change reflects a slight acceleration in inflation.
The European Central Bank also left its interest rates unchanged, Yahoo Finance reported and Morningstar corroborated. The ECB cited an energy‑price shock as a factor in its decision.
MarketWatch said the Fed’s pause on rate hikes may not last as prices continue to rise. The outlet noted that inflation pressures remain elevated.
The Federal Reserve uses the PCE index as its preferred measure of inflation, the Hill explained. The index is released monthly by the Bureau of Economic Analysis.
en.context: The personal consumption expenditures index is published each month by the Bureau of Economic Analysis and is the Federal Reserve’s preferred gauge of inflation.

de.title: Fed lässt Zinsen unverändert, während Warsh Zinspolitik anpasst
de.dek: Die Federal Reserve beließ ihren Leitzins am Mittwoch unverändert, und der neue Vorsitzende Jerome Warsh erklärte, die Fed werde ihre Methode zur Zinsfestlegung ändern.
facts: Die Fed beließ ihren Leitzins am Mittwoch unverändert (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
Der Index der persönlichen Konsumausgaben stieg im September auf 3,7 % (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
Der PCE-Index stieg im September nach einem Rückgang im August (The Hill, New York Times).
Die Europäische Zentralbank beließ ihre Zinssätze unverändert (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh kündigte eine Änderung des Zinsfestlegungsverfahrens der Fed an (WPEC, KATU).
body: Jerome Warsh erklärte, dass die Federal Reserve die Art und Weise der Zinsfestlegung ändern werde, so WPEC und KATU. Die Ankündigung erfolgte am selben Tag, an dem die Fed ihre geldpolitische Entscheidung bekannt gab.
Die Federal Reserve beließ ihren Leitzins am Mittwoch unverändert, wie MarketWatch berichtete und der Conduit Street Blog bestätigte. Die Entscheidung hielt die Zielspanne auf dem aktuellen Niveau.

Der Preisindex der persönlichen Konsumausgaben (PCE) stieg im September auf 3,7 %, stellte The Guardian fest. MarketWatch fügte hinzu, dass die Lebenshaltungskosten im letzten Monat erneut stark gestiegen seien.

The Hill und die New York Times berichteten, dass der PCE-Index im September nach einem Rückgang im August gestiegen sei. Beide Medien erklärten, die Änderung spiegele eine leichte Beschleunigung der Inflation wider.

Die Europäische Zentralbank beließ ebenfalls ihre Zinssätze unverändert, wie Yahoo Finance berichtete und Morningstar bestätigte. Die EZB nannte einen Energiepreisschock als Faktor für ihre Entscheidung.
MarketWatch erklärte, dass die Pause der Fed bei den Zinserhöhungen möglicherweise nicht anhalten werde, da die Preise weiter steigen. Das Medium merkte an, dass der Inflationsdruck erhöht bleibe.
Die Federal Reserve nutzt den PCE-Index als ihr bevorzugtes Maß für die Inflation, erläuterte The Hill. Der Index wird monatlich vom Bureau of Economic Analysis veröffentlicht.
de.context: Der Index der persönlichen Konsumausgaben wird jeden Monat vom Bureau of Economic Analysis veröffentlicht und ist der bevorzugte Inflationsindikator der Federal Reserve.

fr.title: La Fed maintient ses taux alors que Jerome Warsh modifie son approche
fr.dek: La Réserve fédérale a laissé son taux directeur inchangé mercredi, tandis que son nouveau président, Jerome Warsh, a annoncé une modification de la méthode de fixation des taux.
facts: La Fed a maintenu son taux directeur inchangé mercredi (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
L'indice des dépenses de consommation personnelle s'est établi à 3,7 % en septembre (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
L'indice PCE a augmenté en septembre après avoir reculé en août (The Hill, New York Times).
La Banque centrale européenne a maintenu ses taux d'intérêt inchangés (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh a annoncé un changement dans l'approche de fixation des taux de la Fed (WPEC, KATU).
body: Selon WPEC et KATU, Jerome Warsh a déclaré que la Réserve fédérale allait modifier sa méthode de fixation des taux d'intérêt. Cette annonce a été faite le jour même de la publication de la décision de politique monétaire de la Fed.
La Réserve fédérale a maintenu son taux directeur inchangé mercredi, selon MarketWatch et Conduit Street Blog. Cette décision maintient la fourchette cible à son niveau actuel.

L'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE) a grimpé à 3,7 % en septembre, a noté The Guardian. MarketWatch a ajouté que le coût de la vie a connu une nouvelle hausse marquée le mois dernier.

The Hill et le New York Times ont rapporté que l'indice PCE a augmenté en septembre après un repli en août. Les deux médias précisent que cette évolution reflète une légère accélération de l'inflation.
La Banque centrale européenne a également laissé ses taux d'intérêt inchangés, d'après Yahoo Finance et Morningstar. La BCE a justifié sa décision par un choc sur les prix de l'énergie.
MarketWatch estime que le gel des taux de la Fed pourrait être de courte durée alors que les prix continuent de grimper, soulignant que les pressions inflationnistes restent élevées.
La Réserve fédérale utilise l'indice PCE comme principal indicateur de l'inflation, a expliqué The Hill. Cet indice est publié mensuellement par le Bureau of Economic Analysis.
fr.context: L'indice des dépenses de consommation personnelle est publié chaque mois par le Bureau of Economic Analysis et constitue l'indicateur de l'inflation privilégié par la Réserve fédérale.

es.title: La Fed mantiene los tipos mientras Warsh cambia el enfoque de las tasas de interés
es.dek: La Reserva Federal mantuvo sin cambios su tasa de política monetaria este miércoles, y su nuevo presidente, Jerome Warsh, afirmó que la Fed modificará su método para fijar los tipos.
facts: La Fed mantuvo sin cambios su tasa de política monetaria el miércoles (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
El índice de gastos de consumo personal subió al 3,7 % en septiembre (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
El índice PCE aumentó en septiembre tras haber caído en agosto (The Hill, New York Times).
El Banco Central Europeo mantuvo sin cambios sus tipos de interés (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh anunció un cambio en el enfoque de la Fed para la fijación de tipos (WPEC, KATU).
body: Jerome Warsh afirmó que la Reserva Federal modificará la forma en que fija los tipos de interés, según informaron WPEC y KATU. El anuncio se produjo el mismo día en que la Fed publicó su decisión de política monetaria.
La Reserva Federal mantuvo sin cambios su tasa de política monetaria el miércoles, según informó MarketWatch y confirmó Conduit Street Blog. La decisión mantiene el rango objetivo en su nivel actual.
El índice de precios de los gastos de consumo personal (PCE) subió al 3,7 % en septiembre, señaló The Guardian. MarketWatch añadió que el coste de la vida volvió a subir bruscamente el mes pasado.
The Hill y el New York Times informaron que el índice PCE aumentó en septiembre tras un descenso en agosto. Ambos medios señalaron que este cambio refleja una ligera aceleración de la inflación.

El Banco Central Europeo también mantuvo sin cambios sus tipos de interés, según informó Yahoo Finance y corroboró Morningstar. El BCE citó un choque en los precios de la energía como factor determinante en su decisión.
MarketWatch señaló que la pausa de la Fed en las subidas de tipos podría no prolongarse mientras los precios sigan subiendo. El medio destacó que las presiones inflacionistas siguen siendo elevadas.
La Reserva Federal utiliza el índice PCE como su medida de inflación preferida, explicó The Hill. El índice es publicado mensualmente por la Oficina de Análisis Económico.
es.context: El índice de gastos de consumo personal es publicado cada mes por la Oficina de Análisis Económico y es el indicador de inflación preferido de la Reserva Federal.

it.title: La Fed mantiene i tassi invariati; Warsh cambia l'approccio alla politica monetaria
it.dek: La Federal Reserve ha lasciato invariato il tasso di riferimento mercoledì, mentre il nuovo presidente Jerome Warsh ha annunciato una modifica al metodo di fissazione dei tassi.
facts: La Fed ha mantenuto invariato il tasso di riferimento mercoledì (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
L'indice delle spese per il consumo personale è salito al 3,7% a settembre (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
L'indice PCE è aumentato a settembre dopo il calo di agosto (The Hill, New York Times).
La Banca Centrale Europea ha lasciato invariati i tassi di interesse (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh ha annunciato un cambiamento nell'approccio della Fed alla fissazione dei tassi (WPEC, KATU).
body: Secondo quanto riportato da WPEC e KATU, Jerome Warsh ha dichiarato che la Federal Reserve modificherà le modalità di fissazione dei tassi di interesse. L'annuncio è avvenuto in concomitanza con la pubblicazione della decisione di politica monetaria della Fed.

La Federal Reserve ha mantenuto invariato il tasso di riferimento mercoledì, come riportato da MarketWatch e confermato dal Conduit Street Blog. La decisione mantiene l'intervallo target al livello attuale.

L'indice dei prezzi delle spese per il consumo personale (PCE) è salito al 3,7% a settembre, ha osservato The Guardian. MarketWatch ha aggiunto che il costo della vita è tornato a crescere nettamente lo scorso mese.

The Hill e il New York Times hanno riportato che l'indice PCE è aumentato a settembre dopo il calo di agosto. Entrambe le testate hanno affermato che tale variazione rifletta una leggera accelerazione dell'inflazione.

Anche la Banca Centrale Europea ha lasciato invariati i tassi di interesse, come riportato da Yahoo Finance e corroborato da Morningstar. La BCE ha citato lo shock dei prezzi dell'energia come uno dei fattori determinanti della decisione.

MarketWatch ha sottolineato che la pausa della Fed nel rialzo dei tassi potrebbe non essere duratura, poiché i prezzi continuano a salire. La testata ha notato che le pressioni inflazionistiche rimangono elevate.
La Federal Reserve utilizza l'indice PCE come misura preferita dell'inflazione, ha spiegato The Hill. L'indice è pubblicato mensilmente dal Bureau of Economic Analysis.
it.context: L'indice delle spese per il consumo personale è pubblicato ogni mese dal Bureau of Economic Analysis ed è l'indicatore di inflazione preferito dalla Federal Reserve.

pt.title: Fed mantém taxas inalteradas enquanto Warsh altera abordagem aos juros
pt.dek: A Reserva Federal manteve a sua taxa de referência na quarta-feira, e o novo presidente, Jerome Warsh, afirmou que a Fed irá alterar o seu método de fixação de taxas.
facts: A Fed manteve a sua taxa de referência inalterada na quarta-feira (MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog).
O índice de despesas de consumo pessoal subiu para 3,7% em setembro (The Guardian, MarketWatch).
O índice PCE aumentou em setembro após ter caído em agosto (The Hill, New York Times).
O Banco Central Europeu manteve as suas taxas de juro inalteradas (Yahoo Finance, Morningstar).
Jerome Warsh anunciou uma alteração na abordagem da Fed para a fixação de taxas (WPEC, KATU).
body: Jerome Warsh afirmou que a Reserva Federal irá modificar a forma como fixa as taxas de juro, de acordo com a WPEC e a KATU. O anúncio ocorreu no mesmo dia em que a Fed divulgou a sua decisão de política monetária.
A Reserva Federal manteve a sua taxa de referência inalterada na quarta-feira, reportou a MarketWatch e confirmou o Conduit Street Blog. A decisão manteve o intervalo meta no nível atual.
O índice de preços de despesas de consumo pessoal (PCE) subiu para 3,7% em setembro, notou The Guardian. A MarketWatch acrescentou que o custo de vida voltou a subir acentuadamente no mês passado.
The Hill e o New York Times reportaram que o índice PCE aumentou em setembro após um declínio em agosto. Ambos os veículos afirmaram que a alteração reflete uma ligeira aceleração da inflação.

O Banco Central Europeu também manteve as suas taxas de juro inalteradas, reportou a Yahoo Finance e corroborou a Morningstar. O BCE citou um choque nos preços da energia como um fator na sua decisão.
A MarketWatch afirmou que a pausa da Fed nas subidas de taxas poderá não durar, dado que os preços continuam a subir. O veículo notou que as pressões inflacionistas permanecem elevadas.
A Reserva Federal utiliza o índice PCE como a sua medida de inflação preferencial, explicou The Hill. O índice é publicado mensalmente pelo Bureau of Economic Analysis.
pt.context: O índice de despesas de consumo pessoal é publicado mensalmente pelo Bureau of Economic Analysis e é o indicador de inflação preferido da Reserva Federal.

zh.title: 美联储维持利率不变，沃什调整利率设定方法
zh.dek: 美联储周三维持政策利率不变，新任主席杰罗姆·沃什表示，美联储将改变其利率设定方式。
facts: 美联储周三维持政策利率不变（MarketWatch, Conduit Street Blog）。
个人消费支出指数9月份升至3.7%（The Guardian, MarketWatch）。
PCE指数在8月份下降后，于9月份回升（The Hill, New York Times）。
欧洲央行维持利率不变（Yahoo Finance, Morningstar）。
杰罗姆·沃什宣布美联储将调整利率设定方法（WPEC, KATU）。
body: 据WPEC和KATU报道，杰罗姆·沃什表示，美联储将修改利率设定方式。该声明与美联储公布政策决议于同一日发布。
MarketWatch报道并经Conduit Street Blog确认，美联储周三维持政策利率不变，将目标区间维持在当前水平。
《卫报》指出，个人消费支出（PCE）价格指数9月份升至3.7%。MarketWatch补充称，上个月生活成本再次大幅上涨。
《国会山报》和《纽约时报》报道称，PCE指数在8月份下降后，于9月份有所回升。两家媒体均表示，这一变化反映出通胀略有加速。
据Yahoo Finance报道并经Morningstar证实，欧洲央行同样维持利率不变。欧洲央行将能源价格冲击列为此次决议的考量因素。
MarketWatch表示，由于物价持续上涨，美联储暂停加息的状态可能无法持久。该媒体指出，通胀压力依然高企。
《国会山报》解释称，美联储将PCE指数作为首选的通胀衡量指标。该指数由美国经济分析局每月发布。
zh.context: 个人消费支出指数由美国经济分析局每月发布，是美联储首选的通胀衡量指标。

ja.title: 米連邦準備制度理事会が金利を据え置き、ウォルシュ議長が金利設定手法の変更を示唆
ja.dek: 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）は水曜日、政策金利を据え置いた。あわせてジェローム・ウォルシュ新議長は、金利設定の手法を変更する方針を明らかにした。
facts: FRBは水曜日、政策金利を据え置いた（マーケットウォッチ、コンジット・ストリート・ブログ）。
9月の個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数は3.7%に上昇した（ガーディアン、マーケットウォッチ）。
PCE価格指数は8月に低下した後、9月に上昇した（ザ・ヒル、ニューヨーク・タイムズ）。
欧州中央銀行（ECB）は金利を据え置いた（ヤフー・ファイナンス、モーニングスター）。
ジェローム・ウォルシュ氏は、FRBの金利設定手法の変更を発表した（WPEC、KATU）。
body: WPECおよびKATUによると、ジェローム・ウォルシュ氏は、連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が金利設定の手法を変更すると述べた。この発表は、FRBが政策金利の決定を公表した同日に行われた。
マーケットウォッチおよびコンジット・ストリート・ブログの報道によれば、FRBは水曜日、政策金利を据え置いた。これにより、目標レンジは現行水準に維持される。
ガーディアンは、9月の個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数が3.7%に上昇したと報じた。また、マーケットウォッチは、先月の生活費が再び急上昇したと付け加えた。
ザ・ヒルとニューヨーク・タイムズは、PCE価格指数が8月に低下した後、9月に上昇したと報じた。両紙は、この変動がインフレのわずかな加速を反映しているとしている。
ヤフー・ファイナンスおよびモーニングスターの報道によると、欧州中央銀行（ECB）も金利を据え置いた。ECBは決定の要因として、エネルギー価格のショックを挙げている。
マーケットウォッチは、物価上昇が続いているため、FRBによる利上げ停止は長く続かない可能性があると指摘した。同メディアは、インフレ圧力が依然として高い水準にあると述べている。
ザ・ヒルによれば、FRBはインフレの主要指標としてPCE価格指数を採用している。同指数は米経済分析局によって毎月発表される。
ja.context: 個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数は、米経済分析局が毎月発表しており、連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）がインフレの主要な指標として利用している。

ko.title: 미 연준 금리 동결…워시 의장, 금리 결정 방식 변경 예고
ko.dek: 미 연방준비제도가 수요일 정책 금리를 동결한 가운데, 제롬 워시 신임 의장은 금리 설정 방식의 변경을 시사했다.
facts: 미 연준은 수요일 정책 금리를 동결했다 (마켓워치, 컨듀잇 스트리트 블로그).
9월 개인소비지출(PCE) 가격지수가 3.7%로 상승했다 (더 가디언, 마켓워치).
PCE 지수는 8월 하락 이후 9월에 다시 상승했다 (더 힐, 뉴욕타임스).
유럽중앙은행(ECB)은 금리를 동결했다 (야후 파이낸스, 모닝스타).
제롬 워시 의장은 연준의 금리 설정 방식 변경을 발표했다 (WPEC, KATU).
body: WPEC와 KATU에 따르면, 제롬 워시 의장은 연방준비제도가 금리 설정 방식을 수정할 것이라고 밝혔다. 이번 발표는 연준의 통화정책 결정 발표와 같은 날 이루어졌다.
마켓워치와 컨듀잇 스트리트 블로그는 연준이 수요일 정책 금리를 동결했다고 보도했다. 이번 결정으로 목표 금리 범위는 현 수준을 유지하게 됐다.
더 가디언은 9월 개인소비지출(PCE) 가격지수가 3.7%로 상승했다고 전했다. 마켓워치는 지난달 생활비가 다시 급격히 상승했다고 덧붙였다.
더 힐과 뉴욕타임스는 8월에 하락했던 PCE 지수가 9월에 다시 상승했다고 보도했다. 두 매체 모두 이러한 변화가 인플레이션의 완만한 가속화를 반영한다고 분석했다.
야후 파이낸스와 모닝스타는 유럽중앙은행(ECB) 역시 금리를 동결했다고 보도했다. ECB는 이번 결정의 요인으로 에너지 가격 충격을 꼽았다.
마켓워치는 물가가 계속 상승함에 따라 연준의 금리 인상 중단 상태가 오래가지 않을 수 있다고 분석하며, 인플레이션 압력이 여전히 높은 수준이라고 지적했다.
더 힐은 연준이 PCE 지수를 선호하는 인플레이션 측정 지표로 사용한다고 설명했다. 해당 지수는 경제분석국(BEA)이 매달 발표한다.
ko.context: 개인소비지출(PCE) 지수는 경제분석국이 매월 발표하며, 미 연방준비제도가 인플레이션을 측정하는 핵심 지표로 활용한다.

en.dek: The Federal Reserve left its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday after the personal consumption expenditures index rose to 3.7% in September.
body: The Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday. According to MarketWatch and Conduit Street Blog, the Fed held rates steady at the current level.
The decision followed a series of rate hikes earlier in the year. According to Conduit Street Blog, the Fed had raised rates in September.
The pause came after the personal consumption expenditures price index rose to 3.7% in September. According to The Guardian and MarketWatch, the PCE inflation index increased to 3.7% in September.
The index had fallen in August. According to The Hill and the New York Times, the PCE index fell in August before rising in September.
The PCE is the Fed's preferred measure of inflation. According to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, the PCE tracks changes in consumer prices.
The Fed said it will monitor economic data closely. According to the Fed, the decision reflects recent inflation data.
Market watchers note that the pause may not last as prices continue to rise. According to MarketWatch, the Fed's pause on rate hikes may not last as prices continue to rise.
The European Central Bank also left its rates unchanged. According to Yahoo Finance and Morningstar, the ECB left its rates unchanged.
facts: Fed policy rate unchanged on Wednesday
PCE inflation index rose to 3.7% in September
PCE inflation index fell in August
Fed had raised rates in September
en.title: Fed holds interest rates steady on Wednesday
en.context: The personal consumption expenditures inflation index is released monthly by the Bureau of Economic Analysis and is the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation.

de.title: Fed hält die Zinssätze am Mittwoch unverändert
Fed hält Zinssätze am Mittwoch konstant

en.dek: The Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday after the personal consumption expenditures index rose to 3.7% in September.
body: According to MarketWatch and Conduit Street Blog, the Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday. The decision followed a series of rate hikes earlier in the year.
According to The Guardian and MarketWatch, the personal consumption expenditures price index rose to 3.7% in September. The index had fallen in August.
According to the Bureau of Economic Analysis, the PCE index is the Fed's preferred measure of inflation. It tracks changes in consumer prices.
According to the Fed, the decision reflects the recent inflation data. The Fed said it will monitor economic data closely.
According to Conduit Street Blog, the Fed had raised rates in September. The policy rate has been held at this level since the last meeting.
According to MarketWatch, the policy rate influences mortgage rates, car loans, and credit card interest. The rate affects borrowing costs across the economy.
According to MarketWatch, the Fed's pause on rate hikes may not last as prices continue to rise. The Fed will reassess in future meetings.
facts: Fed policy rate unchanged on Wednesday.
PCE inflation index increased to 3.7% in September.
PCE inflation index fell in August.
Fed held rates steady after September hikes.
en.title: Fed holds interest rates steady on Wednesday
en.context: The PCE inflation index is released monthly by the Bureau of Economic Analysis. It is the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation.

de.title: Fed hält die Zinssätze am Mittwoch unverändert

en.dek: The Federal Reserve left its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday after a slight rise in September's PCE inflation index.
body: The Federal Reserve left its policy rate unchanged on Wednesday, according to MarketWatch and Conduit Street Blog. The decision followed a series of rate hikes earlier in the year.
The policy rate was unchanged. The rate has been held at this level since the last meeting.
The PCE inflation index, the Fed's preferred measure of inflation, rose slightly in September, according to The Hill and the New York Times. The index increased after falling in August.
The PCE index measures changes in the prices of goods and services purchased by consumers. It is used by the Fed to gauge inflation trends.
The Fed's decision to keep rates steady reflects the recent inflation data. MarketWatch noted that the move comes after the PCE index rose.
Conduit Street Blog reported that the Fed held rates steady after September hikes. The blog highlighted that the policy rate remained unchanged.
The decision is part of the Fed's strategy to manage inflation while supporting economic growth. The Fed has signaled that it will monitor economic data closely.
The PCE inflation data is released monthly by the Bureau of Economic Analysis. The latest data shows a modest increase in consumer prices.
The Fed's policy rate is a key tool for influencing borrowing costs across the economy. The rate affects mortgage rates, car loans, and credit card interest.
facts: Fed policy rate unchanged on Wednesday.
PCE inflation index increased in September.
PCE inflation index fell in August.
Fed held rates steady after September hikes.
en.title: Fed holds interest rates steady on Wednesday
en.context: The PCE inflation index is the Federal Reserve's preferred measure of inflation and is released monthly by the Bureau of Economic Analysis.
